roads.name: Scandia Trail North
words: Sweeping and steady: 9 curves in 2.7 miles.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 895 to 918 ft, with 122 ft of up and down along the way.
Built up in places.
July highs average 82°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.62 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Theodore Wirth Parkway
words: Properly twisty: 16 curves in 2.6 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 821 to 903 ft, with 348 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
12 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 83°F.
